Emily — great to connect. Welcome aboard. I sketched a pragmatic staggered onramp that has worked for similar customers; attaching the SKU map and a short playbook to accelerate the private offer request.

Proposed phasing (high level):
1) Pilot (30 days): small SKU set, enable prefix caching and tuned batch size; smoke tests + perf targets. Goal: validate latency & cost per token for representative workloads.
2) Scale (30–90 days): widen SKU coverage, enable reduced quantization for perf-sensitive endpoints, onboard GCP co-sell motions and enable marketplace listing.
3) Commit drawdown (starting month 3): tiered draw schedule where first tranche converts to committed credits on acceptance; subsequent tranches release based on usage thresholds and a simple remediation SLA.

Immediate asks for your team to unblock private offer submission:
- Confirm pilot SKUs and expected monthly spend for pilot month (we can mirror that in the PO request)
- Legal: are you OK with a short MOA? If yes, sign and we’ll kick DocuSign.
- Procurement: preferred billing flow (pass-through vs reseller).

Attachments: gcp_sku_map_v1.csv (SKU / endpoint mapping), private_offer_playbook_v0.3.pdf (ops runbook & co-sell checklist).

I propose a working session Thursday 09/02 at 10:00am ET. If that works, I’ll send the invite and agenda.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Partnerships Lead, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
